annotations.title: Get current posted waits at a Parky park

description: Use this when a visitor asks for current wait times, how long the lines are, or what is open or down at a Disney or Universal park, such as EPCOT, Magic Kingdom, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, Disneyland, Epic Universe or Islands of Adventure. Pass the park name as park_id; no lookup is needed. Each entry has a type: ride (always listed; "unavailable", not closed, when no live value is reported), experience, show or meet (listed only while reported). This tool does not predict future waits.

park_id.description: Park key (magic-kingdom), canonical park ID, park name, or shorthand such as mk, epcot, hs, ak, dl, dca, usf, ioa, epic or ush. A park name works directly, with no lookup first.

ride_id.description: Optional ride ID to return one ride only.

name: parky_get_waits
title: Get current posted waits at a Parky park
